data.content_ref: inline:The 'refuted if' branch is internally incoherent: the first refutation condition says SRC_001 is refuted if it invokes counterexample rejection rather than deriving parity from divisibility, but the second condition says it is refuted if its derivation does NOT pass through 138/3 = 46 being even. Deriving evenness from the divisibility lattice IS passing through the fact that 138/3 = 46 is even, so the two conditions target the same derivation step and pull in opposite directions. This makes the refutation logic self-undermining rather than a coherent test of the contradiction claim.
